relationships.subject: Alyref
relationships.evidence_quote: Alyref directly binds to m5C-modified Ccn3 mRNA and promotes its nuclear export

relationships.subject: Alyref
relationships.evidence_quote: Loss of Alyref impaired Ccn3 mRNA export, reduced Ccn3 expression

relationships.subject: Alyref
relationships.evidence_quote: and was associated with an increased level of MMP-9, a key mediator of neuroinflammatory pain signaling

relationships.subject: Alyref
relationships.evidence_quote: Conditional deletion of Alyref in NaV1.8+ nociceptive neurons significantly exacerbated thermal and cold hypersensitivity, mechanical allodynia, and hyperalgesia

key_findings: Alyref is upregulated in DRG nociceptors after CFA and its loss in NaV1.8+ neurons exacerbates inflammatory pain.
Alyref exports m5C-modified Ccn3 mRNA; loss lowers Ccn3 and raises MMP-9.
